name: A Nya
source:
Air heroines start to feel bad in the head and grow cat ears as a result. Summer with these girls will bring lots of memories full of love and excitement!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
空中女主角开始感到头部不适，并因此长出了猫耳朵。和这些女孩一起度过的夏天将会带来很多充满爱和兴奋的回忆！
